Row.Text: Adds a second Naturalist/Mountie button to pick the tiles of a National Park yourself (needs the Dev CE GameCore). Human player only: the AI keeps building the standard four-tile parks. Single player only.
Fewest tiles a custom National Park may have (1 to 32).
Most tiles a custom National Park may have (1 to 32). Values below the minimum are raised to the minimum.
Which world wonders may be part of a National Park. Applies to the standard Naturalist action and to the AI too. Wonder tiles must also pass the appeal rule.
Stonehenge, Hanging Gardens, Temple of Artemis, Machu Picchu, Mahabodhi Temple and Chichen Itza.
No wonder tile may be part of a park (the standard rule).
Choose the wonders yourself in the list below.
Checked wonders may be part of a National Park. Used when World Wonders is set to Custom.
Which districts may be part of a National Park. Applies to the standard Naturalist action and to the AI too. District tiles must also pass the appeal rule.
No district tile may be part of a park (the standard rule).
Choose the districts yourself in the list below.
Checked districts may be part of a National Park. Used when Districts is set to Custom.
